title: Charge-induced isomerization in alkyl imine molecular motors: a reduced energy barrier approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8053-8059
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06792D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Syed Bilal Ahmed, Hei Wun Kan, King-Cheong Lam, Cho-Tung Yip
This study explores an electron-induced mechanism for isomerization in chiral N-alkyl imine-based molecular motors. The introduction of charge reduces the energy barrier, resulting in more favorable dynamics compared to light-driven processes.
